seed_references.verdict: Strong primary source (full text via DHQ) for 'preservation needs SLAs and archival products planned from the start'; single self-reported lab, 2016-2017 data, not shown to generalise beyond a university-funded lab.

Sound taxonomy (migration, emulation, computer museums) citing Rosenthal 2015 that legal and image-creation barriers push emulation costs out of reach; mostly dated and gives no cost figures, so low direct relevance to economics.

Binding: Potential Impact asks 'would someone actually use this?' and the IP/privacy clause restricts the demo to content with clear rights; live page matches the Coordinator snapshot on these clauses.

deliverables.title: Donation-funded nonprofit (Internet Archive style)
deliverables.strongest_counterevidence: Internet Archive already occupies this niche at 210+ PB and still ran a USD 4.06M deficit in FY2025, so a newcomer competes for the same donations with far less trust.

deliverables.title: Community/volunteer-run preservation (ArchiveTeam, Flashpoint, Ruffle style)
deliverables.strongest_counterevidence: Communities already self-organise without a new platform (GeoCities Japan, Cohost, Flashpoint), and game content carries rights-holder opposition (ESA).

deliverables.title: Institutional / consortium / legal-deposit model
deliverables.strongest_counterevidence: Public funding is politically fragile (Trove near-closure 2023, FlyBase 2025) and single incidents can take an archive offline for years (British Library 2023); a hackathon product cannot become an institution.
deliverables.closest_existing_alternative: National library web archives (NLA Trove, UK Web Archive, NDL WARP) and King's Digital Lab SLAs

deliverables.title: Freemium / SaaS capture service
deliverables.strongest_counterevidence: Rhizome's hosted Conifer service was wound down in 2025-2026, and the paying side of this market is capture (institutions, lawyers), not explorers.

deliverables.title: Bring-your-own-storage: platform keeps index + client-side player only (hybrid with M3 deposit)
deliverables.strongest_counterevidence: It shifts storage risk onto contributors, the party least able to sustain it, so link rot returns unless originals are also deposited with an institution; no working example of the M5+M3 hybrid was found.
deliverables.closest_existing_alternative: Conifer 'download WACZ, self-host with redirect' option; ReplayWeb.page; Arweave/ArDrive
